name: bauble-of-mending-banish-draw-class-bonus-life
notes:
Bauble of Mending (hLHpI5rHIK, REGALIA/ITEM): "Banish Bauble of Mending: Draw a card. Class Bonus: Up to one target non-Human ally you control gets +1 LIFE until end of turn. (Apply the additional effect only if your champion's class matches this card's class.)" Implemented as a correctly-categorized $activateAbilityAbilities['hLHpI5rHIK:0'] entry (GeneratedCode/GeneratedMacroCode.php) -- the free/repeatable field-ability dictionary -- offered through the fast-opportunity MZMAYCHOOSE flow (same mechanism as cosmic-astroscope-rest-glimpse), NOT the reserve-cost $cardActivatedAbilities dictionary (contrast with the Baby Blue Slime routing bug documented just above this fixture's definition in create-prd-ability-fixtures.php, which this fixture's existence helped confirm is specific to that card's miscategorization and not a systemic fast-opportunity problem). ActivatedAbilityCost() (Custom/GameLogic.php) pays the 'Banish CARDNAME' cost -- moving it to myBanish -- BEFORE the ability closure runs, so Draw($player, 1) and the class-bonus MZMAYCHOOSE both genuinely fire from a real activation, not a seeded precondition.

The champion's CardID is patched directly to Silvie, With the Pack (nllCALIXDT, TAMER) to satisfy the Class Bonus (IsClassBonusActive($player, ['TAMER'])), matching the established technique used throughout this suite's other Silvie fixtures (e.g. freezing-hail-blue-slime-class-bonus-buff) rather than leveling up a real champion. Red Slime (mttsvbgl6f, TAMER/BEAST/SLIME -- non-Human) is seeded onto the field as the class-bonus +1 LIFE target; its own On Death ability is not exercised here.

Action sequence, verified live via FIXTURE_DEBUG zone/queue dumps: (1) P1 attempts to pass, opening the fast-opportunity window and offering 'myField-1@Activate-0@Banish' (the MZMAYCHOOSE Param's label 'Banish' must be included verbatim -- submitting just 'myField-1@Activate-0' is rejected as an 'Invalid selection', unlike the ability-index-only matching DecodeOpportunityAbilityChoice() uses for the myField!CustomInput!Activate: N direct-click path). (2) Choosing that selection pays the Banish cost (Bauble moves myField-1 -> myBanish-0, Red Slime shifts down to myField-1) and queues Draw's AfterAction plus a new MZMAYCHOOSE ('myField-1', i.e. Red Slime) for the class-bonus target. (3) Choosing 'myField-1' applies the bonus: Red Slime's TurnEffects becomes ["ENTERED_THIS_TURN","hLHpI5rHIK"], and GameLogic.php's life-computation switch (~14408) adds +1 LIFE for the 'hLHpI5rHIK' marker, so ObjectCurrentHP goes from the printed 2 to 3 -- confirmed via the computed_life_equals assertion. Hand count also goes 7 -> 8 confirming Draw resolved.

Break/restore verified: temporarily commenting out the 'Class Bonus' MZMAYCHOOSE block's AddDecision calls in the hLHpI5rHIK:0 activateAbilityAbilities closure (GeneratedCode/GeneratedMacroCode.php) made step-3's computed_life_equals assertion fail (myField-1 computed life stayed 2, and the fixture's own decision_queue_empty check also broke because the still-hand-authored action 2 then had no matching decision to answer); restoring the block made it pass again. Re-ran the full suite after restoring: no regressions.

rulesClauses: Banish Bauble of Mending: Draw a card.
Class Bonus: Up to one target non-Human ally you control gets +1 LIFE until end of turn.
